name: ARC3 Human Think-Aloud
summary: 陌生交互游戏中的观测、动作与同步口述记录。
summaryEn: Observations, actions and synchronized think-aloud records from unfamiliar interactive games.
scale: 144 successful human trajectories; 250 agent trajectories; 25 games
scaleZh: 144 条成功的人类轨迹；250 条智能体轨迹；25 个游戏
organizationsZh: ARC3 Human Think-Aloud 发布团队
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Card specifies CC BY 4.0; check upstream game and agent-trace terms separately
licenseZh: 数据卡标注 CC BY 4.0；上游游戏与智能体数据条款需另核对
wmNote: 人类部分筛选成功轨迹，存在选择偏差；智能体轨迹重用公开来源，口述不等于真实内部机制。
wmNoteEn: Human trajectories are success-selected; agent traces reuse public sources, and verbal reports do not establish internal mechanisms.

evidence.sourceTitle: ARC3 Human Think-Aloud official release documentation
evidence.locator: Dataset Overview; Data Organization; actions / observed_actions / timeline
evidence.statement: The official release pairs gameplay actions and visual observations with timestamps, audio and transcripts. Ordered interaction traces and outcome annotations expose action-conditioned game transitions rather than dialogue-only state.
